name: New West Zone
summary: Bodakdev, Vastrapur, Thaltej, Gota and the SG Highway corridor.

name: West Zone
summary: Navrangpura, Paldi, Ashram Road and CG Road — the established west bank.

name: Central Zone
summary: The historic core: Kalupur, Khadia, Dariyapur and the old-city bazaars.

name: North Zone
summary: Sabarmati, Chandkheda, Motera — along the river toward Gandhinagar.

name: South Zone
summary: Maninagar, Isanpur, Vatva — south of the riverbed.

name: East Zone
summary: Former mill lands and workers' colonies, now mixed commercial and residential.

name: South-East Zone
summary: Nikol, Vastral and large-scale housing growth along major arterials.
